newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends weaker as dollar firms. [CORRECTED 23:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends weaker as dollar firms. [CORRECTED 23:30 GMT]

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar as the U.S. currency firmed (corrects from "U.S. currency weakened") during the day on international markets, dealers said.
The forint closed at 174.40/45 to the dollar, compared to 173.85/90 at the opening.
The Hungarian currency widened its gap from the central bank's bid to 50 pips from 35 pips at the opening, they said.
